In reality, for a Rhodesian Ridgeback, ear set and carriage are structural identifiers; the low confidence of the pose auditor on ear keypoints suggests these may be structurally ambiguous or malformed, not just relaxed. The Router also missed the severity implication of the 'Tail' being untestable—combined with the puppy's hind limb issues, this points to a broader posterior anatomy failure.

This indicates severe anatomical hallucination or melting, not just blending. The Router also missed the implication of the adult dog's low-confidence hind limb keypoints (Left Hip: 0.04, Right Knee: 0.04), suggesting the adult dog's rear anatomy is also compromised, likely hidden by the lying pose but structurally unsound. The 'gibberish' tag is a confirmed AI artifact.
